test_title: PYST 30: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word in brackets to fill in the blank.**

The gentle lapping of waves _________ (for) the shore was the only thing that could be heard.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Against**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• An antonym is a word that means the opposite of another word.
 
• The word in brackets is "**for**", which means towards or in the direction of.
 
• The opposite of "**for**" is "**against**", which means in opposition to or in contact with.

Thus, **option 4** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Across** means from one side to the other.
 
• **Beneath **means under or below.
 
• **Pro **means in favour of or support.
